summary: Tested Nivesh CAS Parser (Google Document AI) integration — 3rd provider in CAS parser dispatch. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass: admin endpoint returns nivesh_cas_parser_configured=true, PUT switches between all 3 providers (casparser_api/claude_vision/nivesh_cas_parser), invalid provider rejected with ok:false, public /api/cas-parser-provider/active returns minimal shape, /api/admin/secrets lists all 4 GOOGLE_DOCAI_* keys under category=parsing and shows configured=true in preview env, services.nivesh_cas_parser.is_configured() True with secrets and False when missing, normalizer output for sample PDF has full Claude/CAS-Connect schema (statement_info, investor_info, portfolio_summary, accounts, holdings.{equities, preference_shares, sovereign_gold_bonds, mutual_funds_demat, mutual_fund_folios}, transactions.{demat_transactions, mutual_fund_transactions}), normalize() handles minimal input gracefully, claude_cas_mapper.map_to_internal() consumes normalized output and produces 110 internal holdings (target was >=100). Frontend component CasConfigSection.jsx verified by source inspection — has all 3 data-testid buttons (cas-provider-casparser/claude/nivesh) and the 'Switched to Nivesh CAS Parser (Document AI)' toast string. Live UI click test was not executable because /admin route redirects to / when accessed via cookie-only session in headless playwright (SPA appears to require Google OAuth popup state, not server cookie alone). Provider was reset to 'casparser_api' as requested. Live Document AI parse was intentionally NOT triggered (GCP cost).
action_items: Main agent can self-verify the Admin UI 3-button render + toast by logging in via Google OAuth in a real browser (priyankamantri@gmail.com or aporwal107@gmail.com) — backend is fully validated, only the live click-and-toast loop remains unproven.
test_credentials.md still says 'Valid values: casparser_api (default) | claude_vision' — update to include 'nivesh_cas_parser' so the file reflects the new third option.
critical_code_review_comments: services.nivesh_cas_parser.is_configured() checks only 3 of the 4 documented secrets (CREDENTIALS_JSON, PROJECT, PROCESSOR) — GOOGLE_DOCAI_LOCATION is intentionally optional with default 'us'. This matches the request spec but means is_configured() returns True even without LOCATION; review_request item said 'all 4 secrets must be set'. Recommend either (a) updating the test contract to 3-of-3 (current behaviour), or (b) add LOCATION to is_configured() bool — currently it's only used via _location() default. Non-blocking.

VALID_PROVIDERS in routes/admin.py is correctly extended; PUT returns ok:false (HTTP 200) for invalid provider rather than HTTP 400 — slightly non-RESTful but matches existing pattern for this endpoint, no change needed.
/api/cas-parser-provider/active correctly omits *_configured fields (admin-only data not leaked) — good.

Normalizer is 870 lines in a single file — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into nivesh_cas_normalizer/ package (text_extractors.py, table_classifiers.py, row_extractors.py) for maintainability.
